notes.title: v1.01 Patch
notes.content:
The following issue(s) were resolved:
[i]- Updated Grocery Stocker NPC to appear at appropriate location despite turning in respective Union Card.[/i]
     
Questline would previously be inaccessible if their respective Union Card was given away, locking player out of obtaining an item necessary for the final ending.
This change should be available to any current save file as well.
